title: Medevac Partnership
description: Package about the partnership between the 379th Expeditionary Medical Group and a host nation hospital and how patients can get care in minutes. When the call comes in for a medical evacuation, time is critical; and for wounded warriors, they may not have hours to wait for an air evacuation out of the country. Sound bites include Col. Rachel Lefebvre.  Produced by Tech Sgt. Kevin Nichols.
keywords: Wounded Warrior, medical evacuation, Kevin Nichols., Rachel Lefebvre, hospital, patients, 379th Expeditionary Medical Group
